task: Find a Coursera course on Sustainable Agriculture practices, and detail the course's objectives and the background of the lead instructor.
answer: Course found: Sustainable Agricultural Land Management (University of Florida) at https://www.coursera.org/learn/sustainable-agriculture. COURSE OBJECTIVES: The course covers agricultural and urban water quality issues in Florida, their bases, land and nutrient management strategies, and the science and policy behind best management practices (BMPs); students learn to evaluate BMP research and analyze its role in determining practices and policies that protect water quality. Skills you'll gain: Environmental Issue, Water Resource Management, Environmental Regulations, Water Resources, Water Quality, Land Management. LEAD INSTRUCTOR BACKGROUND: George J. Hochmuth, Ph.D., Professor at the University of Florida, leads the Research Program in Urban and Agricultural Fertilization and Nutrient Management Practices. His research addresses environmental science questions on water quality and nutrient/water management in urban and agricultural settings, including alternative water sources, efficient irrigation, improved water management, and careful fertilizer nutrient use (especially nitrogen and phosphorus) to prevent environmental losses.
